src: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.

Siso ist seit 2012 Künstler im Studio Arts Program; dies ist seine erste Einzelausstellung. Siso wurde 1962 in Madrid geboren und wuchs in Venezuela, Trinidad und Miami auf; in seinen frühen Zwanzigern zog er mit seiner Familie in den Süden Kaliforniens.

src: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hyp: Meisterhaft arbeitet Siso über verschiedene Themenbereiche hinweg und hat eine produktive Reihe von Landschaften, Porträts und Stillleben geschaffen, die in Acryl, Pastell, Bleistift oder Aquarell ausgeführt sind. Ausgehend von Familienporträts, eigenen Referenzfotos und Erinnerungen zeigen seine farbenfrohen Kompositionen seinen breiten Interessen- und Fertigkeitsbereich in verschiedenen Medien. Sisos tropische Landschaften und Meeresbilder spiegeln die Geografien seiner Vergangenheit wider, verwenden reiche Muster und integrieren Menschen, um bedeutende Verbindungen zwischen Kultur, Erinnerung und Umwelt herzustellen. Siso betitelt seine Kunstwerke in einer Mischung aus Spanisch und Englisch, was die gefeierten und integralen Komplexitäten seines Lebens im Los Angeles County symbolisiert. "Vicente Siso: Erinnerungen an Land und Wasser" eröffnet am Samstag, den 13. Januar, mit einer Empfang von 18 bis 20 Uhr. Die Ausstellung ist bis Sonntag, den 3. März, zu sehen.

src: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.

In ähnlicher Weise kann dies in den Stadtzentren Sydneys, die sich um Verkehrsknotenpunkte befinden, in verkleinertem Maßstab eintreten. Auch die inneren Vororte müssen sich entwickeln, mit einem Wandel zu erschwinglicherem Apartment-Wohnen in Höhen unterhalb der Baumkronen an wichtigen Standorten. Natürlich muss das neue Wachstum im Wohnungsbau gut geplant sein und Bäume, Grünanlagen und Parks müssen zusammen mit anderen wichtigen Infrastrukturen integriert werden.

src: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.

Ein möglicher Weg könnte ein unabhängiger Entscheidungsgremium sein, das hochwertiges Design fördert, solange es unter den Baumkronen passt und Familienleben, große Balkone, Gemeinschaftsgärten und ein freundliches Erscheinungsbild integriert. Dies könnte die Rolle des derzeitigen Regierungsbauarchitekten von NSW sein, der innerhalb eines sorgfältig erstellten, konformen Codes arbeitet.

src: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.

Unsere Fähigkeit, online einzukaufen, hat unser Einkaufsverhalten verändert, und Freunde und Familie scheinen aufgrund der Smartphone-Kommunikation näher beieinander zu sein. All diese Anpassungen von einem System zum anderen können auch in unserer baulichen Umgebung durch einen planerischen Fokus auf adaptive Wiederverwendung statt auf den Vorrang der Denkmalschutzmaßnahmen stattfinden.

src: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. src: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.

In Iran haben Frauen zum Beispiel durch die Weigerung, Gesetzen zu gehorchen, die sie zur Kopfbedeckung verpflichten, die größte Bedrohung für die islamische Regierung seit 40 Jahren dargestellt. In einigen der 130 Länder mit Mindestquoten für die weibliche Repräsentation in der Regierung, wie Indien, hat sich der Widerstand der Männer gegen weibliche Wähler*innen und politische Aktivitäten gemildert.

src: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. src: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. src: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses
hyp: Deutsche Bauern und Zugfahrer erschrecken Deutschlands Chefs.

src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
hyp: In Deutschland, wo Arbeitnehmer und Arbeitgeber viele Unternehmen gemeinsam leiten, ist ein großer Streik ungewöhnlich. Eine Welle großer Streiks ist fast unvorstellbar. Diese Mistgabelmop, wie manche es nennen, wird die harmonischen Arbeitsbeziehungen Deutschlands im kommenden Jahr auf die Probe stellen.

src: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.

Diese Maßnahmen brachten die Landwirte an den Rand. Sie mobilisierten auch andere verärgerte Arbeiter, die bereits unter dem Druck von Inflation, Rezession und der selbst auferlegten Sparpolitik der Regierung litten. Am 9. Januar begannen Fahrer von Güter- und Personenzügen bei der Deutschen Bahn, dem nationalen Eisenbahnverkehrsunternehmen, einen Streik wegen Arbeitszeiten und Löhnen.

src: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.

Die Landwirte schätzten die Zugeständnisse als unzureichend ein. Am 4. Januar verhinderte eine aggressive Gruppe von ihnen Robert Habeck, dem Wirtschaftsminister, die Ausschiffung von einer Fähre auf seiner Rückkehr von einem Familienurlaub. src: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. src: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Local bosses are already fretting about a German version of the gilets jaunes protests in France in 2018, which culminated in yellow-jacketed demonstrators torching cars on the Champs-Elysées and the police stepping in with tear gas. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. This year is shaping up to be even tougher.

src: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."

src: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."

src: Thus, we had the introduction of the Cost of Living (Tenant protection) (Scotland) Act 2022 nearly 18 months ago which sought to cap rents for a limited period to ease the pressures of the cost-of-living crisis. What we find now from the latest Scottish Government statistics is that, in the last year alone, average rents have increased in all sized properties, ranging from the lowest rise of 11.7 per cent for one-bedroom to the highest figure of 14.3 per cent for two-bedroom homes. Every type of property (from one to four bedroom to a room in a property) has had a double digit increase in rents since the Cost of Living legislation was introduced in October 2022, exceeding the annual average increases in rents over the previous 12 years by a factor of at least three.
hyp: So hatten wir vor fast 18 Monaten die Einführung des Cost of Living (Tenant protection) (Scotland) Act 2022, der den Mietpreis für einen begrenzten Zeitraum begrenzen sollte, um die Belastungen der Lebenshaltungskrise zu lindern. Was wir jetzt aus den neuesten Statistiken der schottischen Regierung feststellen, ist, dass sich die durchschnittlichen Mietpreise im letzten Jahr allein in allen Größenordnungen von Immobilien erhöht haben, von einem Anstieg von 11,7 Prozent für Einzimmerwohnungen bis zu einem Höchstwert von 14,3 Prozent für Zweizimmerwohnungen. Jede Art von Immobilie (von Einzimmerwohnungen bis zu Vierzimmerwohnungen und Zimmer in einer Immobilie) hat seit Einführung der Cost of Living-Gesetzgebung im Oktober 2022 einen zweistelligen Anstieg der Mieten verzeichnet, der die durchschnittlichen jährlichen Mietpreissteigerungen der vorherigen 12 Jahre um mindestens das Dreifache übersteigt.

src: There were plenty of warnings from all involved in the housing sector that this would happen, but these went unheeded. src: With the Cost of Living Act legislation ending on 31 March 2024, a new consultation document seeks to extend controls on the level of rent increases that can be levied in the coming year. hyp: Mit dem Ende des Gesetzes zur Bekämpfung der Lebenshaltungskosten am 31. src: This tapering proposal would set rent increases between 6 per cent and a maximum of 15 per cent which, ironically, would be higher than historic annual price rises. src: Unfortunately, this consultation paper seems like a further attempt to impose controls on the sector. The greater the investment in the PRS the more stability will be created in the housing market. Increasing volumes in both the PRS and social housing markets will stabilise rents over time as demand meets supply and equilibrium is achieved. Only by adopting these measures will we start to address the current housing crisis. Anything else is simply not going to work.

Although we come from a variety of backgrounds, including jail administration, civil rights advocacy, and experience being incarcerated in jail, we all agree that there must be independent oversight of Washington's jails.

src: More than 130,000 people were booked into a Washington jail in 2022, and yet there is startlingly little information about what occurs once they get there. src: What we found demonstrates that immediate action is required. Outpacing other states, Washington now has the fourth-highest rate of jail deaths in the nation. This cannot continue.

src: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.

src: For most travelers, the aircraft model isn't a deciding factor when booking a flight. src: Determining which aircraft models are the safest is less straightforward. The National Transportation Safety Board maintains comprehensive databases of information about accidents and incidents. src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. src: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. src: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.
hyp: Meisterhaft bewegt sich Siso durch verschiedene Themen und hat eine umfangreiche Reihe von Landschaftsbildern, Porträts und Stillleben geschaffen, die entweder mit Acryl, Pastell, Bleistift oder Aquarell ausgeführt sind. Inspiriert von Familienporträts, seinen eigenen Referenzfotos und Erinnerungen zeigen seine farbenfrohen Kompositionen seine vielfältigen Interessen und sein Können in verschiedenen Medien. Siso's tropische Landschaften und Meeresblicke spiegeln die Geografien seiner Vergangenheit wider und verwenden reiche Muster, wobei er Menschen einbezieht, um bedeutungsvolle Verbindungen zwischen Kultur, Erinnerung und Umwelt herzustellen. Siso gibt seinen Kunstwerken Titel, die eine Mischung aus Spanisch und Englisch sind, was die gefeierten und integralen Komplexitäten seines Lebens in Los Angeles County widerspiegelt. "Vicente Siso: Erinnerungen an Land und Wasser" eröffnet am Samstag, den 13. Januar, mit einer Vernissage von 18:00 bis 20:00 Uhr. Die Ausstellung ist bis Sonntag, den 3. März, geöffnet.

src: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. src: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses

src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.

Diese Mistgabelmob (als „Mistgabelmob“ von manchen genannt) wird Deutschlands harmonische Arbeitsbeziehungen im kommenden Jahr auf die Probe stellen.

src: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.

Diese Maßnahmen brachten die Landwirte an den Rand. Sie mobilisierten auch andere verärgerte Arbeitnehmer, die bereits unter dem Druck von Inflation, Rezession und der selbst auferlegten Sparpolitik der Regierung litten. Am 9. Januar begannen Lokführer und Zugbegleiter der Deutschen Bahn, der nationalen Eisenbahn, einen Streik wegen Arbeitszeiten und Löhnen.

src: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.

Besonders stark auf den Schienengüterverkehr angewiesen sind die Automobil-, Chemie- und Stahlindustrie, die größten in Deutschland.

src: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. src: The Biden Administration Is Letting Corporate Criminals Off the Hook

src: Tim Whitehouse, a former EPA enforcement attorney and the executive director of Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility, praised the Biden administration's recent improvements on enforcement while acknowledging the strong headwinds such efforts face. src: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.
hyp: Die Probleme bei der EPA sind zwar von denen beim Justizministerium verschieden, aber nicht unverbunden, das Umweltverbrechen über seine Umwelt- und Ressourcenschutzdivision (ENRD) bearbeitet. Im Fiskaljahr 2022 hat die EPA weniger Fälle an das Justizministerium überwiesen (88) als zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt seit 2000 und schloss auch weniger Zivilverfahren ab als seit dieser Zeit. src: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. src: Thus, we had the introduction of the Cost of Living (Tenant protection) (Scotland) Act 2022 nearly 18 months ago which sought to cap rents for a limited period to ease the pressures of the cost-of-living crisis. Every type of property (from one to four bedroom to a room in a property) has had a double digit increase in rents since the Cost of Living legislation was introduced in October 2022, exceeding the annual average increases in rents over the previous 12 years by a factor of at least three.

src: There were plenty of warnings from all involved in the housing sector that this would happen, but these went unheeded. src: This tapering proposal would set rent increases between 6 per cent and a maximum of 15 per cent which, ironically, would be higher than historic annual price rises. src: Unfortunately, this consultation paper seems like a further attempt to impose controls on the sector. src: The Washington jail system is experiencing a fatality crisis. This is one of the uncomfortable but unavoidable truths we confronted as co-chairs of a legislative task force charged with studying our state's jail system and recommending changes to help make jails safer. Although we come from a variety of backgrounds, including jail administration, civil rights advocacy, and experience being incarcerated in jail, we all agree that there must be independent oversight of Washington's jails.
hyp: Das Gefängnissystem in Washington erlebt eine Krise der Todesfälle. Dies ist eine der unangenehmen, aber unvermeidlichen Wahrheiten, denen wir uns als Mitvorsitzende einer Gesetzeskommission stellten, die mit der Untersuchung unseres Landesgefängnissystems und der Empfehlung von Änderungen zur Verbesserung der Sicherheit in Gefängnissen beauftragt war. Obwohl wir aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen stammen, darunter Gefängnisverwaltung, Bürgerrechtsvertretung und eigene Erfahrungen mit Inhaftierung in Gefängnissen, sind wir uns alle einig, dass es eine unabhängige Aufsicht über die Gefängnisse in Washington geben muss.

src: More than 130,000 people were booked into a Washington jail in 2022, and yet there is startlingly little information about what occurs once they get there. Washington has no statewide office responsible for monitoring jails and reporting data to the public. Some of the only information available relates to deaths in custody.

Washington hat keine landesweite Stelle, die für die Überwachung von Gefängnissen und die Berichterstattung an die Öffentlichkeit zuständig ist. Einige der einzigen verfügbaren Informationen beziehen sich auf Todesfälle in Haft.

src: What we found demonstrates that immediate action is required. Even accounting for Washington's population growth, the Washington jail death rate nearly tripled between 2000 and 2019 - an increase 16 times that of the national average. Outpacing other states, Washington now has the fourth-highest rate of jail deaths in the nation. This cannot continue.

Washington übertrifft andere Bundesstaaten und hat nun die viert-höchste Rate an Todesfällen in Gefängnissen im ganzen Land. So kann es nicht weitergehen.

src: Reversing the trend of jail deaths, and solving the many other issues facing our jails, may require some difficult policy decisions. However, independent oversight of jails is a critical first step toward a safer and more humane jail system. Independent oversight is a demonstrated means of improving transparency and accountability both in Washington and across the country. By our count, at least 25 states have a statewide office responsible for overseeing jails, and all of them have a lower rate of jail deaths than Washington.
hyp: Die Umkehrung des Trends steigender Todesfälle in Gefängnissen und die Lösung der vielen anderen Probleme, mit denen Gefängnisse konfrontiert sind, erfordern möglicherweise schwierige politische Entscheidungen. Eine unabhängige Aufsicht über Gefängnisse ist jedoch ein entscheidender erster Schritt hin zu einem sichereren und humaneren Gefängnissystem. Unabhängige Aufsicht hat sich als Mittel erwiesen, um Transparenz und Rechenschaftspflicht sowohl in Washington als auch im ganzen Land zu verbessern. Nach unserer Berechnung haben mindestens 25 Bundesstaaten eine landesweite Stelle, die für die Aufsicht über Gefängnisse zuständig ist, und alle von ihnen weisen eine niedrigere Rate an Todesfällen in Gefängnissen auf als Washington.

src: Closer to home, Washington has recently established or expanded independent oversight of state prisons, police, schools, and other entities. Jails are the notable exception to oversight of institutions that are responsible for the health and safety of tens of thousands of people.
hyp: In näherer Betrachtung hat Washington kürzlich eine unabhängige Aufsicht über staatliche Gefängnisse, die Polizei, Schulen und andere Einrichtungen eingerichtet oder erweitert. Gefängnisse stellen die bemerkenswerte Ausnahme von der Aufsicht über Institutionen dar, die für die Gesundheit und Sicherheit von Zehntausenden von Menschen verantwortlich sind.

src: An independent jail oversight office can monitor conditions in jails, meet with staff and incarcerated people, report on conditions that they have witnessed firsthand, and even communicate concerns before people are hurt. A jail oversight office can also collect and report data, helping administrators, policymakers, and the public understand our jail system and advocate for data-driven solutions to jail deaths and other problems relating to jails.
hyp: Ein unabhängiges Büro zur Überwachung von Gefängnissen kann die Verhältnisse in Gefängnissen überwachen, sich mit dem Personal und Inhaftierten treffen, über Verhältnisse berichten, die es aus erster Hand beobachtet hat, und sogar Bedenken äußern, bevor Menschen verletzt werden. Ein Büro zur Überwachung von Gefängnissen kann auch Daten sammeln und darüber berichten, was dazu beiträgt, dass Verwalter, politische Entscheidungsträger und die Öffentlichkeit unser Gefängnissystem verstehen und sich für datengestützte Lösungen für Gefängnissterben und andere Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Gefängnissen einsetzen.

src: Oversight is not only for the benefit of incarcerated people. Our task force recognized that an oversight office can partner with overburdened jail systems to provide much-needed assistance and recommendations, including smart policies that promote staff safety and reduce recidivism.
hyp: Kontrolle kommt nicht nur den Inhaftierten zugute. Unsere Taskforce erkannte, dass ein Kontrollamt mit überlasteten Gefängnissystemen zusammenarbeiten kann, um dringend benötigte Unterstützung und Empfehlungen zu leisten, einschließlich intelligenter Richtlinien, die die Sicherheit des Personals fördern und die Rückfallquote senken.

src: Washington state briefly had a statewide jail oversight office from 1981-87, which the United States Department of Justice once trumpeted as a model for systems around the country. src: Independent oversight will promote public trust and data-driven decision-making in a field that has for too long operated without the benefit of transparency. src: How to find out if you're flying on a Boeing 737 MAX
hyp: Wie finde ich heraus, ob ich mit einer Boeing 737 MAX fliege?

src: For most travelers, the aircraft model isn't a deciding factor when booking a flight. But with the majority of Boeing 737 MAX 9 jets grounded around the country after an Alaska Airlines fuselage blowout on Jan. 6, some prospective passengers may want to know how to tell what type of plane they'll be on and which models are the safest. The first is easy enough to answer - the second is a little more complicated.
hyp: Für die meisten Reisenden ist das Flugzeugmodell kein entscheidender Faktor bei der Buchung eines Fluges. Doch mit dem Großteil der Boeing 737 MAX 9 Jets, die im ganzen Land nach einem Riss im Rumpf einer Alaska Airlines Maschine am 6. Januar außer Betrieb genommen wurden, möchten einige potenzielle Passagiere möglicherweise wissen, wie sie feststellen können, welche Art von Flugzeug sie befördert werden und welche Modelle am sichersten sind. Die erste Frage lässt sich leicht beantworten – die zweite ist etwas komplizierter.

src: The airplane model is typically noted in the booking information for a flight. On Google Flights, it's included in the flight details when a listing is expanded, and it's usually listed on individual airlines" reservation pages. If, for some reason, the plane type isn't apparent on Google Flights or the reservation page, sites like Expert Flyer and Seat Guru aggregate flight information like seat maps and aircraft type.
hyp: Das Flugzeugmodell wird in der Regel in den Buchungsinformationen für einen Flug angegeben. Auf Google Flights ist es in den Flugdetails enthalten, wenn eine Auflistung erweitert wird, und wird normalerweise auf den Reservierungsseiten der einzelnen Fluggesellschaften aufgeführt. Wenn aus irgendeinem Grund der Flugzeugtyp auf Google Flights oder der Reservierungsseite nicht ersichtlich ist, aggregieren Seiten wie Expert Flyer und Seat Guru Fluginformationen wie Sitzpläne und Flugzeugtyp.

src: Determining which aircraft models are the safest is less straightforward. The National Transportation Safety Board maintains comprehensive databases of information about accidents and incidents. The Federal Aviation Administration also provides preliminary accident and incident reports, which include the manufacturer of the aircraft involved, from the past 10 days on its Aviation Safety Information Analysis and Sharing page.
hyp: Die Feststellung, welche Flugzeugmodelle am sichersten sind, ist weniger eindeutig. Der Nationale Sicherheitsrat für Transportwesen führt umfassende Datenbanken mit Informationen über Unfälle und Vorfälle. Auch die Federal Aviation Administration stellt vorläufige Unfall- und Vorfallberichte bereit, die den Hersteller des beteiligten Flugzeugs enthalten, und zwar für die letzten 10 Tage auf ihrer Seite zur Analyse und zum Austausch von Informationen zur Flugsicherheit.

src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. According to the report, which was published in September 2023, the Boeing 787 and Airbus A350 are the aircraft models with the fewest total hull losses, an accident in which the aircraft is destroyed beyond repair. There are a few additional models in the report that have never experienced a hull loss, including the double-decker behemoth Airbus A380. But those models had accumulated fewer than 1 million departures at the time of the report.
hyp: Eine weitere nützliche Ressource, auf die die FAA verweist, ist die Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, die die Flugsicherheit nach Flugzeugtyp bewertet, indem sie Unfälle nach dem Flugzeugmodell aufschlüsselt. Laut dem Bericht, der im September 2023 veröffentlicht wurde, sind die Boeing 787 und die Airbus A350 die Flugzeugmodelle mit den wenigsten Totalverlusten, bei denen das Flugzeug irreparabel zerstört wird. Es gibt einige zusätzliche Modelle im Bericht, die noch nie einen Totalverlust erlitten haben, darunter das zweistöckige Schwergewicht Airbus A380. Diese Modelle hatten jedoch zum Zeitpunkt des Berichts weniger als 1 Million Starts absolviert.

src: The report also includes a comparison of hull loss accident rates per million departures, which helps account for the fact that some of the models are more common or have been around longer than others. The Airbus A310, which was introduced in 1983, has the highest rate of hull losses - 2.53 per 1 million departures - among the models that are still in service as passenger aircraft. The Airbus 320 family, which includes the A321 and A319neo, has the lowest rate, at 0.11. The Boeing 737 MAX line, which has been around since 2017, has a rate of 1.48.
hyp: Der Bericht enthält außerdem einen Vergleich der Unfallraten mit Totalschaden pro Million Abflüge, was dazu beiträgt, den Umstand zu berücksichtigen, dass einige Modelle häufiger sind oder schon länger im Einsatz sind als andere. Die Airbus A310, die 1983 eingeführt wurde, weist mit 2,53 pro 1 Million Abflüge die höchste Rate an Totalverlusten unter den Modellen auf, die noch als Passagierflugzeuge im Einsatz sind. Die Airbus A320-Familie, zu der auch die A321 und die A319neo gehören, weist mit 0,11 die niedrigste Rate auf. Die Boeing 737 MAX-Reihe, die seit 2017 im Einsatz ist, hat eine Rate von 1,48.

src: It's important to keep in mind that, even though these rates are per million departures, some of the plane models in this report - for example, the Boeing 727 introduced in 1964 - have been around for decades and consequently had much longer to accumulate an accident record than others.
hyp: Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass einige der in diesem Bericht genannten Flugzeugmodelle – beispielsweise die 1964 eingeführte Boeing 727 – trotz der Tatsache, dass diese Raten pro Million Abflüge angegeben sind, seit Jahrzehnten im Einsatz sind und daher deutlich mehr Zeit hatten, einen Unfallverlauf anzusammeln als andere.

src: Perry Cooper, a media representative from the Port of Seattle, which oversees Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, said in an email that there are a wide variety of reasons accidents occur, ranging from equipment to human error. So while it's easy enough to determine what type of plane you'll be on, it's more complicated to determine what that means from a safety perspective.
hyp: Perry Cooper, ein Medienvertreter des Hafens von Seattle, der den Seattle-Tacoma International Airport verwaltet, erklärte in einer E-Mail, dass es eine Vielzahl von Gründen für Unfälle gibt, die von Gerätefehlern bis hin zu menschlichem Versagen reichen. Während es also einfach ist festzustellen, welche Art von Flugzeug man befördert wird, ist es komplizierter zu bestimmen, was das aus Sicherheitsgründen bedeutet.

src: While you can make some comparisons of aircraft models based on the available data, the FAA advises against trying to compare airlines based on their accident records. According to a report cited by the administration, "there currently is no evidence in accident data that would support the ranking of individual airlines based on their safety records."
hyp: Obwohl man Flugzeugmodelle anhand der verfügbaren Daten vergleichen kann, rät die FAA davon ab, Fluggesellschaften anhand ihrer Unfallaufzeichnungen zu vergleichen. Laut einem Bericht, auf den sich die Behörde bezieht, „gibt es derzeit keine Beweise in den Unfallstatistiken, die eine Rangfolge einzelner Fluggesellschaften aufgrund ihrer Sicherheitsbilanz rechtfertigen würden.“

src: While there are often significant differences between airlines" safety records at any given point in time, this is largely due to the "infrequent but catastrophic nature of an air accident," according to the FAA, and these apparent differences between airlines even out over time. The FAA declined a request for comment.
hyp: Obwohl es oft deutliche Unterschiede in den Sicherheitsbilanzen der Fluggesellschaften zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt gibt, liegt dies größtenteils an der "seltenen, aber katastrophalen Natur eines Flugzeugunfalls", so die FAA, und diese scheinbaren Unterschiede gleichen sich im Laufe der Zeit aus. src: In a recent incident involving Betta Edu, the Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Alleviation in President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's administration, there have been calls for her removal from office amid allegations of misappropriation of a N585 million palliative fund. src: As per the leaked memo dated 20 December 2023, Edu directed the Accountant-General to transfer the funds from the account of the National Social Investment Office to the private account of Bridget Oniyelu, the accountant of a Federal Government poverty intervention project called "Grants for Vulnerable Groups," a project under Mrs. Edu's ministry.

src: Speaking on behalf of Edu, Rasheed Zubair, her media aide, asserts that the act is legal within the framework of the Nigerian civil service. It further stipulates, "Any officer who pays public money into a private account is deemed to have done so with fraudulent intention."

src: In general I really like the interplay between the two games. The advantage of shortform stories is that you can "skip to the good part", they can be more immediately engrossing and satisfying. src: The climax of Celeste the commercial game is literally just the pico-8 game, blown up, with several hours of mechanical and narrative buildup letting it pop off way way harder. src: There's another mid-scale version that could've existed between the two that tells the same expanded resonant story but with a tighter runtime and less insane production values. src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. src: How to find out if you're flying on a Boeing 737 MAX

src: For most travelers, the aircraft model isn't a deciding factor when booking a flight. But with the majority of Boeing 737 MAX 9 jets grounded around the country after an Alaska Airlines fuselage blowout on Jan. 6, some prospective passengers may want to know how to tell what type of plane they'll be on and which models are the safest. The first is easy enough to answer - the second is a little more complicated.

Lakini kwa kuwa ndege nyingi za Boeing 737 MAX 9 zimesimama kote nchini baada ya mlipuko wa sehemu ya mwili wa ndege ya Alaska Airlines tarehe 6 Januari, abiria wengine wanaoweza kusafiri wanaweza kutaka kujua jinsi ya kujua aina ya ndege watakayotumia na ni modeli zipi ni salama zaidi. Jibu la la kwanza ni rahisi kabisa - jibu la pili ni kidogo ngumu zaidi.

src: The airplane model is typically noted in the booking information for a flight. On Google Flights, it's included in the flight details when a listing is expanded, and it's usually listed on individual airlines" reservation pages. If, for some reason, the plane type isn't apparent on Google Flights or the reservation page, sites like Expert Flyer and Seat Guru aggregate flight information like seat maps and aircraft type.

Katika Google Flights, hurejelewa katika maelezo ya safari ya ndege wakati orodha inapanuliwa, na kwa kawaida huorodheshwa kwenye kurasa za uhifadhi za mashirika ya ndege binafsi. Ikiwa, kwa sababu yoyote, aina ya ndege haionekani kwenye Google Flights au kwenye ukurasa wa uhifadhi, tovuti kama Expert Flyer na Seat Guru huunganisha taarifa za safari ya ndege kama ramani za viti na aina ya ndege.

src: Determining which aircraft models are the safest is less straightforward. The National Transportation Safety Board maintains comprehensive databases of information about accidents and incidents. The Federal Aviation Administration also provides preliminary accident and incident reports, which include the manufacturer of the aircraft involved, from the past 10 days on its Aviation Safety Information Analysis and Sharing page.

Bodi ya Taifa ya Usalama wa Usafiri (National Transportation Safety Board) inahifadhi vitabu vya habari vya kina kuhusu ajali na matukio. Shirika la Uendeshaji Anga la Shirikisho (Federal Aviation Administration) pia hutoa ripoti za awali za ajali na matukio, ambazo zinajumuisha mzalishaji wa ndege iliyohusika, za siku kumi za hivi karibuni kwenye ukurasa wake wa Uchambuzi na Kushiriki Habari za Usalama wa Anga.

src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. According to the report, which was published in September 2023, the Boeing 787 and Airbus A350 are the aircraft models with the fewest total hull losses, an accident in which the aircraft is destroyed beyond repair. There are a few additional models in the report that have never experienced a hull loss, including the double-decker behemoth Airbus A380. But those models had accumulated fewer than 1 million departures at the time of the report.

Kulingana na ripoti, ambayo ilichapishwa mnamo Septemba 2023, ndege za Boeing 787 na Airbus A350 ndizo muundo wa ndege unaopoteza miili yake kidogo zaidi, ajali ambayo ndege inaharibiwa haziwezi kurejeshewa. src: The report also includes a comparison of hull loss accident rates per million departures, which helps account for the fact that some of the models are more common or have been around longer than others. The Airbus A310, which was introduced in 1983, has the highest rate of hull losses - 2.53 per 1 million departures - among the models that are still in service as passenger aircraft. The Airbus 320 family, which includes the A321 and A319neo, has the lowest rate, at 0.11. The Boeing 737 MAX line, which has been around since 2017, has a rate of 1.48.

src: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. src: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses

src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.

Diese „Mistgabelmoppe“ (Pitchfork-Masse), wie einige sie nennen, wird im kommenden Jahr die harmonischen Arbeitsbeziehungen in Deutschland auf die Probe stellen.

src: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.
hyp: Die Proteste wurden offensichtlich durch die Entscheidung der Regierung ausgelöst, die Subventionen für Dieselkraftstoff, der in der Landwirtschaft verwendet wird, zu beenden und eine Ausnahmeregelung von der Kfz-Steuer für Landfahrzeuge zu streichen. Diese Maßnahmen trieben die Landwirte an den Rand des Abgrunds. Es mobilisierte auch andere wütende Arbeiter, die bereits unter dem Druck der Inflation, der Rezession und der selbst auferlegten Sparpolitik der Regierung litten. Am 9. Januar begannen die Fahrer von Güter- und Personenzügen bei der Deutschen Bahn, der nationalen Eisenbahn, einen Streik wegen Arbeitszeiten und Löhnen.

src: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.

Die Landwirte wiesen die Zugeständnisse als unzureichend zurück. Am 4. Januar verhinderte eine aggressive Gruppe von ihnen, dass Robert Habeck, der Wirtschaftsminister, bei seiner Rückkehr von einem Familienurlaub aus einem Fährschiff aussteigen konnte. Der Streik im Eisenbahnverkehr könnte den Unternehmen täglich 100 Mio. Euro (110 Mio. US-Dollar) kosten, wenn er sie zwingt, die Produktion zu unterbrechen. src: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. src: The Biden Administration Is Letting Corporate Criminals Off the Hook

src: Tim Whitehouse, a former EPA enforcement attorney and the executive director of Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility, praised the Biden administration's recent improvements on enforcement while acknowledging the strong headwinds such efforts face. "It takes years of sustained funding and political support to build a good enforcement program," he told me. "The instability in Congress is not only demoralizing to EPA staff but undermines their ability to think strategically over the long term."

src: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

Vor seinem Wechsel zur EPA war Uhlmann, der stellvertretende EPA-Sekretär für Durchsetzung, langjähriger Leiter der Sektion für Umweltverbrechen innerhalb der ENRD von 1990 bis 2007. Die EPA übermittelt ihre schwersten zivil- und strafrechtlichen Fälle an die ENRD, die als relativ unterfinanziertes Büro oft auf Unterstützung anderer Behörden angewiesen ist, um zu entscheiden, welche Fälle sie aufgreifen soll. Im Haushaltsjahr 2022 übermittelte die EPA weniger Fälle an das Justizministerium (88) als zu jedem Zeitpunkt seit 2000 und schloss auch weniger zivilrechtliche Gerichtsverfahren als in den Jahren zuvor. Wie das Umweltintegritätsprojekt feststellt, schloss selbst Trumps EPA durchschnittlich 94 zivilrechtliche Fälle pro Jahr und übermittelte 106 Fälle an das Justizministerium.

src: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. While watchdogs have lauded some steps the department has taken during Merrick Garland's tenure as attorney general - like finally establishing a database on corporate crime - Biden's DOJ has also leaned heavily on leniency agreements that allow companies to defer or avoid prosecution, and encouraged companies to scapegoat individual employees so as to avoid a broader charge. src: How to find out if you're flying on a Boeing 737 MAX

src: For most travelers, the aircraft model isn't a deciding factor when booking a flight. But with the majority of Boeing 737 MAX 9 jets grounded around the country after an Alaska Airlines fuselage blowout on Jan. 6, some prospective passengers may want to know how to tell what type of plane they'll be on and which models are the safest. The first is easy enough to answer - the second is a little more complicated.

Januar die meisten dieser Jets weltweit am Boden bleiben, möchten einige potenzielle Passagiere vielleicht wissen, wie man das Flugzeugmodell identifiziert und welche Modelle als sicher gelten. Die erste Frage lässt sich einfach beantworten – die zweite ist etwas komplizierter.

src: The airplane model is typically noted in the booking information for a flight. On Google Flights, it's included in the flight details when a listing is expanded, and it's usually listed on individual airlines" reservation pages. If, for some reason, the plane type isn't apparent on Google Flights or the reservation page, sites like Expert Flyer and Seat Guru aggregate flight information like seat maps and aircraft type.
hyp: Das Flugzeugmodell wird typischerweise in den Buchungsinformationen für einen Flug angegeben. Wenn aus irgendeinem Grund das Flugzeugmodell auf Google Flights oder der Buchungsseite nicht ersichtlich ist, aggregieren Seiten wie Expert Flyer und Seat Guru Fluginformationen wie Sitzpläne und Flugzeugtypen.

src: Determining which aircraft models are the safest is less straightforward. The National Transportation Safety Board maintains comprehensive databases of information about accidents and incidents. The Federal Aviation Administration also provides preliminary accident and incident reports, which include the manufacturer of the aircraft involved, from the past 10 days on its Aviation Safety Information Analysis and Sharing page.
hyp: Die Bestimmung, welche Flugzeugmodelle die sichersten sind, ist weniger direkt. Die National Transportation Safety Board führt umfassende Datenbanken mit Informationen über Unfälle und Vorfälle. Die Federal Aviation Administration stellt außerdem vorläufige Unfall- und Vorfallsberichte zur Verfügung, die unter anderem den Hersteller der beteiligten Flugzeuge enthalten, und zwar seit den letzten 10 Tagen auf ihrer Seite Aviation Safety Information Analysis and Sharing.

src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. According to the report, which was published in September 2023, the Boeing 787 and Airbus A350 are the aircraft models with the fewest total hull losses, an accident in which the aircraft is destroyed beyond repair. There are a few additional models in the report that have never experienced a hull loss, including the double-decker behemoth Airbus A380. But those models had accumulated fewer than 1 million departures at the time of the report.

Laut dem im September 2023 veröffentlichten Bericht sind die Boeing 787 und Airbus A350 die Flugzeugmodelle mit den geringsten Gesamtschaden am Rumpf, einem Unfall, bei dem das Flugzeug so stark beschädigt ist, dass es nicht repariert werden kann. Es gibt im Bericht noch einige weitere Modelle, die nie einen Rumpfschaden erlitten haben, darunter das Doppelstock-Riesenflugzeug Airbus A380. Diese Modelle hatten jedoch zum Zeitpunkt der Veröffentlichung weniger als eine Million Abflüge absolviert.

src: The report also includes a comparison of hull loss accident rates per million departures, which helps account for the fact that some of the models are more common or have been around longer than others. The Airbus A310, which was introduced in 1983, has the highest rate of hull losses - 2.53 per 1 million departures - among the models that are still in service as passenger aircraft. The Airbus 320 family, which includes the A321 and A319neo, has the lowest rate, at 0.11. The Boeing 737 MAX line, which has been around since 2017, has a rate of 1.48.
hyp: Der Bericht enthält auch einen Vergleich der Unfallraten bei Schäden am Rumpf pro Million Abflüge, der die Tatsache berücksichtigt, dass einige Modelle häufiger oder länger im Einsatz sind als andere. Die Airbus A310, die 1983 eingeführt wurde, weist mit 2,53 Schäden am Rumpf pro Million Abflüge die höchste Rate unter den Modellen auf, die noch als Passagierflugzeuge im Einsatz sind. Die Airbus 320-Familie, zu der die A321 und die A319neo gehören, hat mit 0,11 die niedrigste Rate. Die Boeing 737 MAX-Reihe, die seit 2017 im Einsatz ist, hat eine Rate von 1,48.

src: It's important to keep in mind that, even though these rates are per million departures, some of the plane models in this report - for example, the Boeing 727 introduced in 1964 - have been around for decades and consequently had much longer to accumulate an accident record than others.

src: Perry Cooper, a media representative from the Port of Seattle, which oversees Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, said in an email that there are a wide variety of reasons accidents occur, ranging from equipment to human error. src: While you can make some comparisons of aircraft models based on the available data, the FAA advises against trying to compare airlines based on their accident records. src: Bring back oversight for WA's jails. Lives depend on it

src: The Washington jail system is experiencing a fatality crisis. This is one of the uncomfortable but unavoidable truths we confronted as co-chairs of a legislative task force charged with studying our state's jail system and recommending changes to help make jails safer. Although we come from a variety of backgrounds, including jail administration, civil rights advocacy, and experience being incarcerated in jail, we all agree that there must be independent oversight of Washington's jails.
hyp: ワシントン州の刑務所システムは、死亡事故の危機に直面しています。これは、私たちが州刑務所システムを研究し、安全性を向上させるための改革を推奨するよう命じられた立法作業部会の共同議長として直面した、不快ではありますが避けられない真実の一つです。私たちは、刑務所運営、人権擁護、刑務所での収監経験など、さまざまな背景を持っていますが、ワシントン州の刑務所に独立した監視が必要であるという点で一致しています。

src: More than 130,000 people were booked into a Washington jail in 2022, and yet there is startlingly little information about what occurs once they get there. hyp: 2022年にワシントン州の刑務所には13万人以上が収容されたが、彼らが刑務所に到着した後の状況に関する情報は驚くほど少ない。ワシントン州には刑務所の監視や公へのデータ報告を担当する州全体レベルの機関はない。入所中の死亡に関する情報がわずかに公開されているだけである。

src: What we found demonstrates that immediate action is required. Even accounting for Washington's population growth, the Washington jail death rate nearly tripled between 2000 and 2019 - an increase 16 times that of the national average. Outpacing other states, Washington now has the fourth-highest rate of jail deaths in the nation. This cannot continue.
hyp: 私たちが発見したことは、直ちに行動を起こす必要があることを示しています。ワシントン市の人口増加を考慮に入れても、2000年から2019年の間にワシントンの刑務所での死亡率はほぼ3倍になり、全国平均の16倍の増加となりました。他の州を上回るペースで、ワシントン州は現在、全国で4番目に高い刑務所での死亡率を誇っています。これは継続できません。

src: Reversing the trend of jail deaths, and solving the many other issues facing our jails, may require some difficult policy decisions. However, independent oversight of jails is a critical first step toward a safer and more humane jail system. Independent oversight is a demonstrated means of improving transparency and accountability both in Washington and across the country. By our count, at least 25 states have a statewide office responsible for overseeing jails, and all of them have a lower rate of jail deaths than Washington.
hyp: 刑務所での死亡率の逆転や、刑務所が直面する他の多くの問題の解決には、困難な政策決定が必要になるかもしれません。しかし、刑務所の独立した監視は、より安全で人道的な刑務所システムへの第一歩として不可欠です。独立した監視は、ワシントン州だけでなく全国的に透明性と説明責任を高める実証済みの手段です。私たちの調査によると、少なくとも25の州に刑務所の監視を担当する州全体での事務所があり、そのすべてがワシントン州よりも刑務所での死亡率が低くなっています。

src: Closer to home, Washington has recently established or expanded independent oversight of state prisons, police, schools, and other entities. Jails are the notable exception to oversight of institutions that are responsible for the health and safety of tens of thousands of people.
hyp: より身近なところでは、ワシントン州は最近、州刑務所、警察、学校、その他の機関に対する独立した監視を確立または強化した。刑務所は、数十万人の人々の健康と安全に責任を負う機関に対する監視の目立つ例外である。

src: An independent jail oversight office can monitor conditions in jails, meet with staff and incarcerated people, report on conditions that they have witnessed firsthand, and even communicate concerns before people are hurt. A jail oversight office can also collect and report data, helping administrators, policymakers, and the public understand our jail system and advocate for data-driven solutions to jail deaths and other problems relating to jails.
hyp: 独立した刑務所監視事務所は、刑務所の状況を監視し、職員や受刑者と面会し、直接目撃した状況について報告し、人々が傷つく前に懸念を伝えることができます。刑務所監視事務所は、データを収集し報告することによっても、管理者、政策立案者、一般市民が刑務所システムを理解し、データに基づいた解決策を提唱するのに役立ちます。

src: Oversight is not only for the benefit of incarcerated people. Our task force recognized that an oversight office can partner with overburdened jail systems to provide much-needed assistance and recommendations, including smart policies that promote staff safety and reduce recidivism.
hyp: 監視は受刑者のためだけではありません。私たちのタスクフォースは、過密状態の刑務所システムと連携して、必要な支援や助言を提供できる監視事務所を設けることが、職員の安全を促進し再犯を減らすための賢明な政策を含む、非常に重要なことだと認識しました。

src: Washington state briefly had a statewide jail oversight office from 1981-87, which the United States Department of Justice once trumpeted as a model for systems around the country. src: Independent oversight will promote public trust and data-driven decision-making in a field that has for too long operated without the benefit of transparency. src: How to find out if you're flying on a Boeing 737 MAX
hyp: ボーイング737 MAXに乗るかどうかを確認する方法

src: For most travelers, the aircraft model isn't a deciding factor when booking a flight. But with the majority of Boeing 737 MAX 9 jets grounded around the country after an Alaska Airlines fuselage blowout on Jan. 6, some prospective passengers may want to know how to tell what type of plane they'll be on and which models are the safest. The first is easy enough to answer - the second is a little more complicated.
hyp: ほとんどの旅行者にとって、航空機の機種は航空券の予約を決める際の決定的な要素ではありません。しかし、1月6日にアラスカ航空の機体爆発事故を受けて、多くのボーイング737 MAX 9機が全国で着陸禁止となり、一部の乗客は、どの機材に乗るのか、どの機種が最も安全なのかを知りたいと思うかもしれません。最初の質問はそれほど難しくありませんが、2つ目は少し複雑です。

src: The airplane model is typically noted in the booking information for a flight. On Google Flights, it's included in the flight details when a listing is expanded, and it's usually listed on individual airlines" reservation pages. If, for some reason, the plane type isn't apparent on Google Flights or the reservation page, sites like Expert Flyer and Seat Guru aggregate flight information like seat maps and aircraft type.
hyp: 飛行機モデルは通常、フライトの予約情報に記載されています。Google Flightsでは、検索結果を拡大するとフライトの詳細に含まれ、個々の航空会社の予約ページにも通常記載されています。何らかの理由でGoogle Flightsや予約ページに飛行機モデルが明記されていない場合、Expert FlyerやSeat Guruなどのサイトは座席図や飛行機モデルを含むフライト情報をまとめています。

src: Determining which aircraft models are the safest is less straightforward. The National Transportation Safety Board maintains comprehensive databases of information about accidents and incidents. The Federal Aviation Administration also provides preliminary accident and incident reports, which include the manufacturer of the aircraft involved, from the past 10 days on its Aviation Safety Information Analysis and Sharing page.
hyp: 最も安全な機種の決定は、より複雑です。国家輸送安全委員会は、事故やインシデントに関する包括的なデータベースを維持しています。連邦航空局も、過去10日間の事故やインシデントの予備報告を提供しており、これには関係する航空機の製造業者も含まれています。これは、航空安全情報分析と共有のページで確認できます。

src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. According to the report, which was published in September 2023, the Boeing 787 and Airbus A350 are the aircraft models with the fewest total hull losses, an accident in which the aircraft is destroyed beyond repair. There are a few additional models in the report that have never experienced a hull loss, including the double-decker behemoth Airbus A380. But those models had accumulated fewer than 1 million departures at the time of the report.
hyp: FAAがリンクするもう一つの有用なリソースは、ボーイングの「1959～2022年 商業ジェット機事故の世界統計要約」で、航空機モデルごとに事故を分類し、機体の安全性を評価しています。2023年9月に発表されたこの報告書によると、ボーイング787とエアバスA350は、機体の総損失（修復不能な状態での破壊）が最も少ない航空機モデルとなっています。報告書には、機体の損失を経験していないモデルもいくつかあり、その中には2階建ての巨大機エアバスA380も含まれています。しかし、これらのモデルは、報告書の時点で100万回未満の離陸回数を積んでいました。

src: The report also includes a comparison of hull loss accident rates per million departures, which helps account for the fact that some of the models are more common or have been around longer than others. The Airbus A310, which was introduced in 1983, has the highest rate of hull losses - 2.53 per 1 million departures - among the models that are still in service as passenger aircraft. The Airbus 320 family, which includes the A321 and A319neo, has the lowest rate, at 0.11. The Boeing 737 MAX line, which has been around since 2017, has a rate of 1.48.
hyp: このレポートには、出発100万回あたりの船体損失事故率の比較も含まれており、一部のモデルが他のモデルよりも一般的であったり、より長期間使用されていることを説明するのに役立っています。1983年に導入されたエアバスA310は、依然として旅客機として運航されているモデルの中で最も高い船体損失率（100万回出発あたり2.53回）を示しています。A320ファミリー（A321とA319neoを含む）は0.11と最も低く、2017年から運用されているボーイング737 MAXは1.48です。

src: It's important to keep in mind that, even though these rates are per million departures, some of the plane models in this report - for example, the Boeing 727 introduced in 1964 - have been around for decades and consequently had much longer to accumulate an accident record than others.
hyp: これらのレートは１００万回離陸分のものではありますが、この報告書に含まれる一部の航空機モデル、例えば１９６４年に導入されたボーイング７２７などは数十年前から存在しており、他のモデルよりもずっと長い期間にわたって事故記録を蓄積してきたため、結果として事故率が高いことになります。

src: Perry Cooper, a media representative from the Port of Seattle, which oversees Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, said in an email that there are a wide variety of reasons accidents occur, ranging from equipment to human error. src: While you can make some comparisons of aircraft models based on the available data, the FAA advises against trying to compare airlines based on their accident records. src: While there are often significant differences between airlines" safety records at any given point in time, this is largely due to the "infrequent but catastrophic nature of an air accident," according to the FAA, and these apparent differences between airlines even out over time. src: In a recent incident involving Betta Edu, the Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Alleviation in President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's administration, there have been calls for her removal from office amid allegations of misappropriation of a N585 million palliative fund. src: As per the leaked memo dated 20 December 2023, Edu directed the Accountant-General to transfer the funds from the account of the National Social Investment Office to the private account of Bridget Oniyelu, the accountant of a Federal Government poverty intervention project called "Grants for Vulnerable Groups," a project under Mrs. Edu's ministry.

src: Speaking on behalf of Edu, Rasheed Zubair, her media aide, asserts that the act is legal within the framework of the Nigerian civil service. It further stipulates, "Any officer who pays public money into a private account is deemed to have done so with fraudulent intention."
hyp: エドゥを代表して、メディア担当のラシード・ズバイールは、この行為はナイジェリア公務員制度の枠組み内で合法であると主張しています。しかし、重要なことに、この要求は2009年のナイジェリア財務規則の複数の条項に違反しており、政府業務における詐欺やその他の腐敗行為を明確に禁止しています。さらに、2009年のナイジェリア財務規則第7章第713条は、「個人の資金はいかなる場合でも政府銀行口座に預け入れられず、公金は私人の口座に預け入れられてはならない」と明記し、「公金を私人の口座に預け入れた者は、詐欺の目的で行ったものとみなされる」と規定しています。

src: There's another mid-scale version that could've existed between the two that tells the same expanded resonant story but with a tighter runtime and less insane production values. src: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.

On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.

src: The Washington jail system is experiencing a fatality crisis. This is one of the uncomfortable but unavoidable truths we confronted as co-chairs of a legislative task force charged with studying our state's jail system and recommending changes to help make jails safer. Although we come from a variety of backgrounds, including jail administration, civil rights advocacy, and experience being incarcerated in jail, we all agree that there must be independent oversight of Washington's jails.

Dies ist eine unangenehme, aber unvermeidliche Wahrheit, mit der wir als Co-Vorsitzende einer Gesetzgebungscommission konfrontiert wurden, die das Studium unseres Gefängnisystems und die Empfehlungen für Veränderungen zur Verbesserung der Sicherheit in den Gefängnissen verantwortlich war. Obwohl wir aus verschiedenen Hintergründen kommen, einschließlich der Gefängnisverwaltung, der Zivilrechtsbewegung und der eigener Erfahrung mit der Haft, stimmen wir alle darin überein, dass es unbedingt unabhängige Überwachung der Gefängnisse in Washington geben muss.

src: More than 130,000 people were booked into a Washington jail in 2022, and yet there is startlingly little information about what occurs once they get there. Washington has no statewide office responsible for monitoring jails and reporting data to the public. Some of the only information available relates to deaths in custody.

Die einzigen Informationen, die verfügbar sind, beziehen sich auf Todesfälle inhaftierter Personen.

src: What we found demonstrates that immediate action is required. Even accounting for Washington's population growth, the Washington jail death rate nearly tripled between 2000 and 2019 - an increase 16 times that of the national average. Outpacing other states, Washington now has the fourth-highest rate of jail deaths in the nation. This cannot continue.

src: Reversing the trend of jail deaths, and solving the many other issues facing our jails, may require some difficult policy decisions. By our count, at least 25 states have a statewide office responsible for overseeing jails, and all of them have a lower rate of jail deaths than Washington.

src: How to find out if you're flying on a Boeing 737 MAX
hyp: Wie man herausfinden kann, ob man auf einem Boeing 737 MAX fliegt

src: For most travelers, the aircraft model isn't a deciding factor when booking a flight. But with the majority of Boeing 737 MAX 9 jets grounded around the country after an Alaska Airlines fuselage blowout on Jan. 6, some prospective passengers may want to know how to tell what type of plane they'll be on and which models are the safest. The first is easy enough to answer - the second is a little more complicated.

Aber nach dem Zusammenbruch der Fuselages einiger Boeing 737 MAX 9-Jets von Alaska Airlines am 6. Januar und der darauf folgenden Landung der meisten dieser Jets in der ganzen Nation, mögen einige potenzielle Passagiere wissen, wie sie feststellen können, welches Flugzeug sie besteigen werden, und welche Modelle am sichersten sind. Die erste Frage ist relativ einfach zu beantworten – die zweite ist etwas komplizierter.

src: The airplane model is typically noted in the booking information for a flight. On Google Flights, it's included in the flight details when a listing is expanded, and it's usually listed on individual airlines" reservation pages. If, for some reason, the plane type isn't apparent on Google Flights or the reservation page, sites like Expert Flyer and Seat Guru aggregate flight information like seat maps and aircraft type.
hyp: Das Flugzeugmodell wird üblicherweise in den Buchungsdaten für ein Flugzeug genannt. Auf Google Flights ist es bei ausgeschalteten Einträgen in den Flugdetails enthalten und wird normalerweise auf den Reservierungsseiten der einzelnen Fluggesellschaften aufgelistet. Falls aus irgendeinem Grund der Flugzeugtyp auf Google Flights oder der Reservierungsseite nicht offensichtlich ist, können Websites wie Expert Flyer und Seat Guru Fluginformationen wie Sitzpläne und Flugzeugtypen aggregieren.

src: Determining which aircraft models are the safest is less straightforward. The National Transportation Safety Board maintains comprehensive databases of information about accidents and incidents. The Federal Aviation Administration also provides preliminary accident and incident reports, which include the manufacturer of the aircraft involved, from the past 10 days on its Aviation Safety Information Analysis and Sharing page.
hyp: Bestimmen, welche Flugzeugmodelle am sichersten sind, ist weniger eindeutig. Die National Transportation Safety Board verfügt über umfassende Datenbanken zu Unfällen und Unfallfällen. Die Federal Aviation Administration bietet auch vorläufige Berichte zu Unfällen und Unfallfällen an, die die Hersteller der beteiligten Flugzeuge auf ihrer Seite Aviation Safety Information Analysis and Sharing in den letzten 10 Tagen enthalten.

src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. According to the report, which was published in September 2023, the Boeing 787 and Airbus A350 are the aircraft models with the fewest total hull losses, an accident in which the aircraft is destroyed beyond repair. There are a few additional models in the report that have never experienced a hull loss, including the double-decker behemoth Airbus A380. But those models had accumulated fewer than 1 million departures at the time of the report.
hyp: Ein weiteres nützliches Ressourcenlink der FAA ist das Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, das die Flugzeugarten-Sicherheit durch die Aufteilung von Unfällen nach dem Flugzeugmodell bewertet. Laut dem Bericht, der im September 2023 veröffentlicht wurde, sind die Boeing 787 und der Airbus A350 die Flugzeugmodelle mit den wenigen insgesamt schweren Wracks, bei denen das Flugzeug außer Dienst gestellt ist, weil es unbrauchbar zerstört wurde. Es gibt ein paar zusätzliche Modelle im Bericht, die noch nie ein Wrack erlitten, darunter der doppelschichtige Riesenflieger Airbus A380. Diese Modelle hatten jedoch weniger als 1 Million Abflüge zum Zeitpunkt des Berichts.

src: The report also includes a comparison of hull loss accident rates per million departures, which helps account for the fact that some of the models are more common or have been around longer than others. The Airbus A310, which was introduced in 1983, has the highest rate of hull losses - 2.53 per 1 million departures - among the models that are still in service as passenger aircraft. The Airbus 320 family, which includes the A321 and A319neo, has the lowest rate, at 0.11. The Boeing 737 MAX line, which has been around since 2017, has a rate of 1.48.

Das Airbus 320-Modell, das A321 und A319neo umfasst, hat die niedrigste Rate, bei 0,11. Die Boeing 737 MAX-Linie, die seit 2017 verfügbar ist, hat eine Rate von 1,48.

src: It's important to keep in mind that, even though these rates are per million departures, some of the plane models in this report - for example, the Boeing 727 introduced in 1964 - have been around for decades and consequently had much longer to accumulate an accident record than others.

src: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.

src: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.

This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.

src: Tierra del Sol is pleased to present "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" at the new gallery location in West Hollywood. Siso has been an artist in the Studio Arts Program since 2012, this marks his debut solo exhibition. Siso was born 1962 in Madrid and raised between Venezuela, Trinidad and Miami; he moved with his family to Southern California in his early 20s.

Siso fæddist 1962 í Madrid og uppvissi milli Venezuela, Trinidad og Miami; hann ferðaði með sínum fjölskyldu til Suðurlands í sinum 20-öld.

src: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. Drawing from family portraits, his own reference photographs, and recollection, his colorful compositions demonstrate his range of interests and skill across media. Siso's tropical landscapes and seascapes reflect the geographies of his past, employing rich patterns and incorporating people to make meaningful connections between culture, memory and the environment. Siso titles his artworks in a mix of Spanish and English, signifying the celebrated and integral complexities of his life in Los Angeles County. "Vicente Siso: Memories of the Land and Water" opens on Saturday, Jan. 13, with a reception from 6-8 p.m. The exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 3.

Með hjálp af sínar sérfræði myndum, sínar eignarmyndir og minni, bætir hann til ríkilega færslu með færslum sem bæta til hans reiknísins og fæðingar á milli myndfræðinga. Siso titlar sér myndfræðinga með smísingi spænska og enska, sem bæta til bæði heilt og viktiga komplikísins í lífsvinnslunum hans í Los Angeles County. src: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.

src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. src: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. src: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. src: Unfortunately, this consultation paper seems like a further attempt to impose controls on the sector. A far simpler solution would be to let the market return to normal, not impose external controls on rent levels, and the result will be lower rent increases than we have seen in the last 18 months. To stabilise rental prices in the long term then the government must encourage greater investment and growth in the private rented sector (PRS) while simultaneously funding a substantial growth in the supply of social housing. The greater the investment in the PRS the more stability will be created in the housing market. Increasing volumes in both the PRS and social housing markets will stabilise rents over time as demand meets supply and equilibrium is achieved. Only by adopting these measures will we start to address the current housing crisis. Anything else is simply not going to work.

src: Masterfully working across subject matter, Siso has generated a prolific series of landscapes, portraits, and still-life works rendered in either acrylic, pastel, pencil or watercolor. src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.
